sys_atf_test.description: The agent row of the ACL matrix on the child tables (AAP 0.5.6): an agent may read and write a task or party whose PARENT case is assigned to that agent, may create, and may never delete. "Assigned only" is a disjunction - assigned_agent = current user OR assigned_group contains current user - so five parent fixtures isolate it: both branches at once, direct-only, group-only, unassigned, and a group the agent is not a member of. Each parent carries one task and one party child, and every child is asserted for read, write and delete, so neither OR branch can pass on the strength of the other and a fail-open ACL cannot hide. This test previously ran RED because the four scripted child-table ACLs dereferenced the reserved word "case" as current.case, which the script engine refuses to compile ("missing name after . operator"), denying every row; those ACLs now read the parent through current.getElement('case') and the test is green.
